skill.name: uspto-database
skill.description: Access USPTO APIs for patent and trademark search, PEDS examination history, assignments, citations, office actions, and TSDR data.
skill.summary: Search patents, trademarks, prosecution histories, assignments, and citations through USPTO data sources.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: The static alerts are false positives after context review. The skill uses documented USPTO endpoints and user-provided API keys, and I found no hidden exfiltration, prompt injection, or unsafe command execution.

remediation.issue: HTTP requests do not show explicit timeout values.
remediation.suggestion: Add request timeouts and retry handling to patent and trademark helper scripts.

remediation.issue: The trademark helper accepts an API key through a command-line flag.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer USPTO_API_KEY for normal use and warn that command-line secrets can appear in shell history.

remediation.issue: Documentation includes inline API key header examples.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer environment-variable examples so users do not paste real keys into prompts or files.

content.user_title: Search USPTO Patent and Trademark Records
content.value_statement: Patent and trademark research often requires several USPTO data sources. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code search patents, trademarks, prosecution history, assignments, and citations.
actual_capabilities: Search PatentSearch data by keyword, inventor, assignee, date, or classification.
Retrieve patent details, abstracts, citations, assignees, inventors, and classifications.
Query PEDS examination history and summarize prosecution events.
Lookup TSDR trademark status, ownership, goods, services, and prosecution history.
Track patent and trademark assignment records through USPTO assignment APIs.
Provide helper scripts for patent search, trademark lookup, and PEDS access.
limitations: Requires a valid USPTO API key for protected API calls.
Depends on USPTO API availability, rate limits, and data coverage.
PEDS support requires the uspto-opendata-python package.
Does not provide legal advice or validity opinions.

use_cases.title: Screen Prior Art
use_cases.description: Find patents by keyword, inventor, assignee, classification, and date before deeper legal review.

use_cases.title: Check Trademark Status
use_cases.description: Review trademark status, owner details, goods and services, and prosecution history from TSDR records.

use_cases.title: Monitor IP Portfolios
use_cases.description: Track patents, trademarks, assignments, citations, office actions, and risk indicators across a portfolio.

prompt_templates.title: Find Patents by Keyword
prompt_templates.prompt: Search USPTO patent records for machine learning camera calibration. Return key patent numbers, titles, assignees, dates, and relevant abstracts.

prompt_templates.title: Check Trademark Status
prompt_templates.prompt: Look up trademark serial number 87654321. Summarize status, owner information, goods and services, and prosecution events.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Prosecution History
prompt_templates.prompt: Use PEDS for application 16123456. Summarize office actions, responses, current status, pendency, and allowance or abandonment signals.

prompt_templates.title: Build an IP Portfolio Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare patents and trademarks for Example Corp. Include patent records, assignments, citations, active marks, risky statuses, and data gaps.

output_examples.input: Search patents assigned to Alphabet about image compression since 2022.
output_examples.output: A concise report lists matching patent numbers, titles, dates, assignees, classifications, and short relevance notes.
A status summary names the mark, current status, filing dates, owner details, goods and services, and attention items.
A timeline summarizes office actions, applicant responses, allowance signals, abandonment risks, and pendency.

best_practices: Store USPTO_API_KEY in an environment variable and avoid posting keys in prompts.
Limit returned fields and use date ranges to reduce API load.
Cache repeated USPTO responses and respect published rate limits.
anti_patterns: Do not paste real API keys into shared chats or repository files.
Do not treat USPTO records as legal advice or final clearance opinions.
Do not run broad portfolio searches without field filters or pagination.

faq.question: Does this skill require a USPTO API key?
faq.answer: Yes. Protected USPTO API calls require a key from the USPTO API Manager.

faq.question: Can it search both patents and trademarks?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers PatentSearch, PEDS, TSDR, and assignment data sources.

faq.question: Does it provide legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It organizes public records and should support review by qualified counsel.

faq.question: Can it analyze prosecution history?
faq.answer: Yes. It can summarize PEDS transaction history, office actions, status, and pendency.

faq.question: What tools are supported?
faq.answer: The skill is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What data limits should users expect?
faq.answer: Results depend on USPTO coverage, API rate limits, and the fields available for each record.
